The City of Waterloo wants to be inclusive. Here's our plan based on what you told us. Feel free to follow our progress by subscribing to this page. We will need your input again soon.
The City of Waterloo's Get READI (Reconciliation, Equity, Accessibility, Diversity and Inclusion) plan will make our city more inclusive by focusing on reconciliation efforts; and how we can become more equitable and accessible. These are the City's focus areas based on your input.
Reconciliation
.
Equity
of resources.
More
Accessible
buildings and programs.
Diversity
in staff and leadership.
Inclusivity
and a sense of belonging.
The Get READI Plan helps you see how you might be more included in community programs and services. Learn more and follow the project.
The Get READI Plan is a tool to guide all City of Waterloo divisions as they plan, budget and provide services and programs for residents and visitors. This Plan is the result of a joint effort involving the City of Waterloo’s READI team, community members and staff. This community-influenced plan will guide the City of Waterloo on its journey to embed READI into the values and work of the corporation.
